limitations: Arbitrary conflicting user scenes may remain unresolved and are reported.
Coarse proxies differ from rendered geometry; balance is not force simulation.
Neutral reuses an existing scan; fitted garments are not cloth simulation.
Libraries are browser-local and packs are limited to 2 MB and 200 presets.
Mobile/touch testing is emulated, not physical-device or assistive-technology certification.
No public hosting deployment was requested or performed.
